sections.heading: Plan Overview
sections.content: The Contoso Health HMO Gold plan provides comprehensive health coverage with a focus on coordinated care through a primary care physician (PCP). This plan requires members to choose a PCP from our network who will coordinate all healthcare services and provide referrals to specialists when needed.

sections.heading: Monthly Premiums
sections.content: Individual coverage: $450/month. Individual + Spouse: $900/month. Family coverage: $1,350/month. Premiums are due on the first of each month.

sections.heading: Deductibles
sections.content: Annual deductible: $500 individual / $1,000 family. The deductible applies to most services except preventive care, which is covered at 100% before the deductible.

sections.heading: Out-of-Pocket Maximum
sections.content: Annual out-of-pocket maximum: $4,000 individual / $8,000 family. Once you reach this limit, the plan pays 100% of covered services for the remainder of the plan year.

sections.heading: Primary Care Visits
sections.content: PCP office visits: $20 copay after deductible. Annual wellness visits and preventive screenings are covered at 100% with no copay. You must select a PCP within 30 days of enrollment.

sections.heading: Specialist Visits
sections.content: Specialist visits require a referral from your PCP. Specialist office visits: $40 copay after deductible. Some specialists may require prior authorization for certain procedures.

sections.heading: Emergency Services
sections.content: Emergency room visits: $250 copay (waived if admitted). Urgent care visits: $50 copay. Emergency services are covered worldwide, but non-emergency out-of-network care is not covered except in specific circumstances.

sections.heading: Hospital Services
sections.content: Inpatient hospital stays: 20% coinsurance after deductible. Prior authorization required for non-emergency admissions. Maximum of 120 days per benefit period.

sections.heading: Prescription Drug Coverage
sections.content: Tier 1 (Generic): $10 copay. Tier 2 (Preferred Brand): $35 copay. Tier 3 (Non-Preferred Brand): $60 copay. Tier 4 (Specialty): 25% coinsurance up to $250. Mail-order prescriptions receive a 90-day supply for the price of 2 copays.

sections.heading: Mental Health Services
sections.content: Outpatient mental health visits: $20 copay (same as PCP visit). Inpatient mental health: 20% coinsurance after deductible. Substance abuse treatment is covered under the same terms. No lifetime limits on mental health benefits.

sections.heading: Preventive Care
sections.content: Annual physical exams, immunizations, cancer screenings (mammograms, colonoscopies, Pap tests), and well-child visits are covered at 100% with no copay or deductible. Preventive care must be received from in-network providers.

sections.heading: Dental and Vision
sections.content: Basic dental and vision coverage is included. Dental: Two cleanings per year, basic restorative services at 50% after $50 deductible. Vision: One eye exam per year, $150 allowance for frames/lenses every 2 years.

sections.heading: Network Requirements
sections.content: This is an HMO plan. All non-emergency care must be received from in-network providers. Out-of-network care is not covered except for emergency services. Check our provider directory at contoso-health.example.com/providers.

sections.heading: Prior Authorization
sections.content: Prior authorization is required for: non-emergency hospital admissions, specialty medications, MRI/CT scans, outpatient surgery, durable medical equipment over $500, and home health services. Failure to obtain prior authorization may result in claim denial.

sections.heading: Appeals Process
sections.content: If a claim is denied, you may file an appeal within 180 days. Level 1 appeals are reviewed within 30 days. Level 2 external reviews are available through an independent review organization. Contact Member Services at 1-800-CONTOSO for assistance.
